nodes.label: Next.js Breaking-Changes Warning
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes vs. training data (APIs, conventions, file structure). Agents must read the guide in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ and heed deprecation notices before writing code, so generated code matches the actual installed version instead of stale assumptions.

nodes.label: iOS/Safari manual install hint
nodes.rationale: iOS Safari has no beforeinstallprompt event, so the app must show a manual hint ("Compartilhar → Adicionar à Tela de Início") to achieve the same install outcome as Android.

nodes.label: Serwist (PWA service worker)
nodes.rationale: Serwist requires webpack, but Next 16 defaults to Turbopack, so dev/build scripts pin --webpack until Serwist adds Turbopack support.

nodes.label: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
nodes.rationale: Usage restricted to src/lib/supabase/admin.ts; must never be exposed to the client, to avoid leaking a privileged Supabase key into the browser.

nodes.label: Pending: final PWA icons
nodes.rationale: Icons currently in public/icons/ are placeholders generated by a script, not final production assets.

nodes.label: Pending: final visual identity
nodes.rationale: Current palette is a neutral premium placeholder, not the final brand identity — flagged as pending because it was never intended as final design.

nodes.label: Progresso / Conquistas (map, badges)
nodes.rationale: Must maintain a non-punitive tone ("manter tom não-punitivo") — an explicit design constraint for how progress/achievement gamification should feel to users.

nodes.label: Analytics de produto (retenção, uso)
nodes.rationale: Product analytics must respect user privacy ("respeitando privacidade") — an explicit constraint on how retention/usage tracking should be implemented.

nodes.label: Graphify working-root note
nodes.rationale: This project's graphify graph must be generated/updated with plano-a/ as the working root, never from the Freelancer/ parent root — prevents the graph from mixing in unrelated sibling projects.

nodes.label: Backlog-to-issue workflow note
nodes.rationale: Each backlog item should become its own issue when planning starts; move it to "Em progresso" and link the PR — keeps the roadmap synchronized with actual work in flight.
